Mirror Anti-Aliasing Fix v{version}
https://github.com/sonochiwa/sa-mirror-anti-aliasing-fix

GTA San Andreas 1.0 US plugin. Requires an ASI loader.

Installation
  Extract MirrorAntiAliasingFix.asi and MirrorAntiAliasingFix.ini into the
  game directory or its scripts directory, then start the game.

Created by sonochiwa. MIT license.
